# Casey debrief

## Reframe

Restate the decision: which twenty customers get a call, to keep the most revenue.

## Ask

Ask what a call costs and what a saved customer is worth. Those two numbers set the metric.

## Structure

Rank by predicted risk, then pick the top twenty. Precision at twenty is the metric.

## Synthesize

Pilot the ranking on one month, compare saves against a random twenty, then scale.
